note: Building-access configuration — the doors and cameras the back office manages. SECURITY MODEL: this file is public (every data file is served to every visitor), so it holds ONLY names and ids — never a bridge URL with credentials baked in, never codes. The bridge URL + token are entered once per admin device in Admin -> Building and live in that device's localStorage. Until a bridge is connected, access passes still work as managed door codes handed to guests (printed instructions / a person at the door); connecting a bridge (see docs/ACCESS-SETUP.md) makes the same passes program real locks and pull real camera views. CHANGE-ME: rename these two example doors to match your building, add more as needed.
